name: At random Full
summary: This EA opens random trades at random intervals with random direction (buy or sell), using configurable lot size, stop loss, and take profit levels. It is essentially a random entry trading system with no technical analysis or strategy logic, relying purely on chance for trade outcomes.
summary_zh: 该EA在随机时间间隔以随机方向（买入或卖出）开仓交易，使用可配置的手数、止损和止盈水平。它本质上是一个随机入场交易系统，没有技术分析或策略逻辑，完全依赖概率决定交易结果。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念完全基于随机性，没有任何技术指标或市场分析方法。入场条件是在每个新的随机时间间隔内，通过随机数生成器决定是否开仓以及开仓方向（买入或卖出）。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈水平，没有移动止损或追踪止损功能。仓位管理仅使用固定的手数设置，没有根据账户余额或风险比例进行动态调整。资金管理方面完全没有风险控制机制，如最大持仓限制、最大回撤保护或连续亏损后的调整。整体而言，这是一个纯粹的随机交易系统，不具有可预测的盈利能力，仅用于测试或演示目的。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is entirely based on randomness, with no technical indicators or market analysis methods involved. Entry conditions are determined at random time intervals, where a random number generator decides whether to open a position and in which direction (buy or sell). Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanisms. Position sizing uses only a fixed lot size setting, without any dynamic adjustment based on account balance or risk ratio. Money management lacks any risk control mechanisms such as maximum position limits, maximum drawdown protection, or adjustments after consecutive losses. Overall, this is a pure random trading system with no predictable profitability, suitable only for testing or demonstration purposes.
pros: 代码简单易懂，适合初学者学习EA基本结构
具有止损和止盈设置，单笔交易风险可控
可用于验证交易平台执行的可靠性和滑点情况
可用于蒙特卡洛模拟，测试随机交易的理论分布
pros_en: Simple and easy-to-understand code, suitable for beginners learning EA basic structure
Has stop loss and take profit settings, controlling risk per individual trade
Can be used to verify trading platform execution reliability and slippage conditions
Can be used for Monte Carlo simulation to test theoretical distribution of random trades
cons: 完全没有交易策略逻辑，纯随机入场无法产生稳定收益
缺乏资金管理机制，没有根据账户风险动态调整仓位
没有考虑点差、手续费和滑点对随机交易结果的严重影响
没有连续亏损保护或最大回撤限制机制
在趋势市场中随机做空或做多会导致系统性亏损
cons_en: No trading strategy logic at all; pure random entry cannot produce consistent profits
Lacks money management mechanisms with no dynamic position sizing based on account risk
Does not account for the serious impact of spread, commission, and slippage on random trade results
No consecutive loss protection or maximum drawdown limit mechanism
Random short or long positions in trending markets will lead to systematic losses
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器，在上升趋势中只做多、下降趋势中只做空，避免逆势随机交易
添加资金管理模块，根据账户余额和风险比例动态调整手数，并设置最大回撤保护
增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高点差时段和低流动性时段开仓
improvements_en: Add a trend filter to only go long in uptrends and only go short in downtrends, avoiding counter-trend random trades
Add a money management module to dynamically adjust lot size based on account balance and risk ratio, with maximum drawdown protection
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid opening positions during high-spread periods and low-liquidity sessions

risk_points: 纯随机交易无策略依据，长期必然亏损（点差和手续费消耗）
没有新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
没有检查账户可用保证金，可能因保证金不足导致开仓失败
没有最大持仓数量限制或连续亏损保护机制
risk_points_en: Pure random trading with no strategy basis will inevitably lose money long-term due to spread and commission erosion
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
No check for account available margin, potentially causing order failure due to insufficient margin
No maximum position limit or consecutive loss protection mechanism
